ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted_norm_entropy_reg_stronger_adv_v4
ir.intuition: Improved gradient sensitivity by removing normalize which flattened advantage_gap distribution, replaced with direct clamp and scaled softplus to maintain meaningful value range. Enhanced leverage of advantage_gap by applying a shifted softplus (softplus(advantage_gap + 2)) to emphasize positive advantage signals and prevent near-zero gradients. Added a stronger entropy regularizer by increasing the gamma hyperparameter and ensuring entropy_gap is non-negative via clamp. Clamped combined logits to avoid saturation in logsigmoid and maintained weighted norm aggregation to prioritize larger weighted losses.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_clamped = clamp(advantage_gap, -10, 10)
adv_activ = softplus(adv_clamped + 2.0)
scaled_adv = beta * adv_activ
diff_logprob = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_diff = alpha * diff_logprob
x = clamp(scaled_diff + scaled_adv, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
weighted_norm_loss = norm(weighted_loss)
entropy_reg = gamma * mean(softplus(clamp(entropy_gap, 0, None)))
final_loss = weighted_norm_loss + entropy_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    entropy_gap = batch.get('entropy_gap', lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape))

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 5.0))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 4.0))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 0.2))

    adv_clamped = ops.clamp(advantage_gap, -10.0, 10.0)
    adv_shifted = ops.add(adv_clamped, 2.0)
    adv_activ = ops.softplus(adv_shifted)
    scaled_adv = ops.mul(beta, adv_activ)

    diff_logprob = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(alpha, diff_logprob)

    x = ops.add(scaled_diff, scaled_adv)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)

    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_norm_loss = ops.norm(weighted_loss)

    entropy_clamped = ops.clamp(entropy_gap, 0.0, 1e9)
    entropy_reg = ops.mul(gamma, ops.mean(ops.softplus(entropy_clamped)))

    final_loss = ops.add(weighted_norm_loss, entropy_reg)
    return final_loss
